hook: Moula Ali hits *14.1°C*; hazy mornings till Nov 17
hook_b: Moula Ali hits *14.1°C*; hazy mornings till Nov 17
tldr: IMD Hyderabad has forecast mist and haze in the mornings till November 17, with partly cloudy skies, but no cold-wave or rain warning.

beats.what: Moula Ali recorded 14.1°C, followed by BHEL and HCU Serilingampally at 14.6°C and Rajendranagar at 14.8°C.
beats.why: Winter chill has set in across Telangana; independent forecaster T Balaji (Telangana Weatherman) expects it to ease after November 20 with rain linked to Cyclone Akvan.
beats.care: Expect cold, hazy mornings tomorrow and through November 17; IMD has issued no warning for chill or rain.
